key_highlights: Global bond yields surge to highest since 2008; US 30-year in worst stretch since 2006, driven by Fed rate-hike bets post-Warsh speech
Japan's 10-year yield hits 3% for first time since 1996; Bessent pressures BOJ for further hikes
US strikes on Iran trigger oil price spike and gold selloff; additional sanctions planned on Iranian banks
Goldman's Kaplan signals lean toward raising rates; Fed-Treasury policy tension emerging
China's official activity gauges hint at economic turnaround; Korea plans near-record bond issuance for 2027 spending
Crypto (BTC briefly $80K, ETH at $2,500) pressured by higher rate expectations; silver and gold also lower
Tesla kills Solar Roof product; Trump power grid policy may benefit TSLA; SoftBank offers $5.5B to OpenAI for data-center venture
European stocks poised to drop as bond yields and oil rise; France 2027 election pressures assets
PetroChina H1 profit jumps 22% to record; ONEOK acquires Brazos Midland gas for $4.425B
Consumer stress signals: firearms retailer files Chapter 11, 161-year-old kids clothing brand closes 29 stores

sectors.trend: Severe global selloff; yields at 2008 highs. US 30-year worst since 2006. Japan 10Y at 3% (1996 high). Korea near-record issuance. Fed hike bets dominate.
sectors.implications: Duration risk elevated across all maturities. Emerging market debt under pressure. Refinancing costs rising globally. CD rates at 4.30% APY signal sustained higher-for-longer regime.

sectors.trend: Oil prices pop on US-Iran strikes. PetroChina record profit (+22%). Goldman sends blunt oil/economy message. Electricity potentially dimming oil's political power.
sectors.implications: Geopolitical premium embedded in crude. Energy equities (CVX, PetroChina) outperforming. ONEOK $4.425B acquisition signals M&A activity in midstream. Watch for supply disruption escalation.

sectors.trend: SoftBank $5.5B data-center deal with OpenAI. Uber burns entire 2026 AI budget in 4 months. Nvidia CEO exclusive. Tesla kills Solar Roof but benefits from Trump grid policy.
sectors.implications: AI capex cycle intensifying but efficiency concerns emerging (Uber). Data-center infrastructure is next growth frontier. Tesla pivot from solar to grid integration.

sectors.trend: Firearms retailer Chapter 11 on falling gun sales. 161-year-old kids clothing brand closes 29 stores. Abercrombie recovery uncertain. Estate sales rising in popularity.
sectors.implications: Consumer discretionary under stress. Discretionary spending shifting to value/secondhand. Retail consolidation accelerating. Signal of broader consumer deleveraging.

sectors.trend: China activity gauges hint at turnaround. Jollibee lists in HK over US. Yuan options at decade-low volatility. Zambia investors back Hichilema despite poll tensions.
sectors.implications: China recovery narrative gaining traction. HK emerging as preferred listing venue. Low yuan vol suggests stable FX but limited upside. EM selectivity critical.

sectors.trend: BTC briefly tops $80K (Strategy stock surges) but rate-hike expectations pressure prices. ETH on-chain metric flashes 'buy' at $2,500. Silver lower on rate fears.
sectors.implications: Crypto remains rate-sensitive. Short-term volatility elevated. ETH $2,500 support level critical. Gold's post-Iran-strike selloff unusual—suggests risk-off is rate-driven, not geopolitical.

key_themes: Global bond selloff and rising rate expectations dominate all asset classes
US-Iran geopolitical escalation driving oil and defense premiums
Fed-Treasury policy divergence (Warsh vs. Bessent) creating uncertainty
Japan's yield normalization (3% 10Y) reshaping global capital flows
AI infrastructure capex cycle (SoftBank/OpenAI, Uber) vs. efficiency concerns
Consumer stress: retail bankruptcies, store closures, shift to value/estate sales
China early recovery signals vs. Korea fiscal expansion creating EM divergence
Energy transition: electricity challenging oil's political dominance; Tesla grid pivot

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Global bond market dislocation / rate spike
risk_assessment.mitigation: Shorten duration to 1-3yr; add TIPS; hedge with long-dated puts on bond ETFs (TLT, IEF). Lock in CD rates at 4.30% APY.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: US-Iran geopolitical escalation / oil supply shock
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight energy (XLE, CVX, PetroChina). Hold 5-10% gold allocation despite short-term selloff. Monitor sanctions timeline.
Reduce concentration in rate-sensitive sectors (REITs, long-duration tech). Diversify into cash equivalents and short-duration credit.
Underweight discretionary retail. Favor essential consumer staples and value/secondhand beneficiaries. Monitor retail bankruptcies.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: France 2027 election uncertainty / European asset pressure
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce EU equity exposure ahead of election cycle. Favor UK (FTSE 100) and Swiss equities as relative hedges.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Japan yield normalization / yen carry trade unwind
risk_assessment.mitigation: Unwind yen-funded positions. Monitor BOJ response to Bessent pressure. Add JGB short positions as yield normalizes.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight energy equities and midstream M&A plays
opportunities.rationale: Iran strikes + Goldman oil outlook + PetroChina record profit + ONEOK $4.425B deal signal sustained energy premium and consolidation

opportunities.recommendation: Position in AI infrastructure / data-center beneficiaries
opportunities.rationale: SoftBank $5.5B OpenAI deal, Uber AI pivot, Nvidia momentum signal multi-year capex supercycle in compute infrastructure

opportunities.recommendation: Add short-duration bonds and TIPS; lock in 4.30% CD rates
opportunities.rationale: Yields at 2008 highs offer attractive entry for short-duration; TIPS hedge inflation from oil spike; CDs lock in current high rates

opportunities.recommendation: Selective China EM exposure on turnaround signal
opportunities.rationale: Official activity gauges hint at recovery; early positioning before consensus. Pair with HK-listed names (Jollibee model)

opportunities.recommendation: Tesla on grid-policy tailwind, not solar
opportunities.rationale: Solar Roof killed but Trump power grid lock-down creates structural demand for Tesla energy/storage. TSLA narrative shifts to grid integration

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce long-duration bond exposure; shift to 1-3yr treasuries
defensive_moves.rationale: US 30-year worst stretch since 2006; global yields at 2008 highs; Fed hike bets still building. Duration risk is primary portfolio threat

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge geopolitical risk with 5-10% gold despite short-term selloff
defensive_moves.rationale: Gold sank on Iran strikes (unusual risk-off pattern) but structural support intact. Rate-driven selloff is temporary; geopolitical premium will reassert

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight consumer discretionary; favor staples and value
defensive_moves.rationale: Firearms Chapter 11, 29 store closures, estate sales rising signal consumer deleveraging. Discretionary spending under structural pressure

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce EU equity exposure; favor UK/Swiss as relative hedges
defensive_moves.rationale: France 2027 election pressuring assets; FTSE 100 dropping on yields/oil. Swiss franc and UK equities offer relative stability

defensive_moves.recommendation: Unwind yen carry trades; monitor BOJ response
defensive_moves.rationale: Japan 10Y at 3% (1996 high) + Bessent pressure on BOJ = carry trade unwind risk. Sudden yen appreciation could trigger global risk-off

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. Bond selloff and rate-hike expectations create headwinds for equities and crypto. Oil spike from Iran adds inflation risk. Expect 5-8% equity volatility. Gold may recover from oversold. Key: Fed-Treasury conflict resolution.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. China turnaround, AI capex cycle, and energy transition provide structural growth. However, sustained higher rates (4.30%+ CDs) and fiscal expansion (Korea, France) cap multiples. 6-12mo: expect rotation from mega-cap tech to energy, infrastructure, and value.

US-Iran sanctions escalation timeline and oil supply impact
BOJ response to Bessent pressure; Japan yield trajectory
China Q3 activity data confirmation of turnaround
Korea 2027 bond issuance execution and fiscal impact
Tesla Q3 delivery and grid-policy revenue impact
Retail bankruptcy wave continuation (firearms, kids clothing)
watch_list: US 10Y and 30Y Treasury yields (2008 high levels)
CD rates (4.30% APY ceiling) and mortgage spread
BOJ policy rate and Bessent-BOJ dialogue
